bio.text: Brent Andrews is an unaffiliated write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Maine in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from the University of North Florida in 2019 and a profession of civil engineer for him.

According to his campaign website, he is a licensed professional engineer whose work has included infrastructure projects at Pearl Harbor, on flood-damaged Vermont roads and at the dry dock at Portsmouth Naval Shipyard.
